_comment: Single source of truth for which reasoning efforts each Grok model accepts.
This CANNOT be probed: `grok --help` declares --reasoning-effort <EFFORT> as free
text and enumerates nothing, so an unsupported tier only fails at launch — after
the call is billed. The values below are user-confirmed, not guessed.
`grok models` is the authority on WHICH models exist; this file is the authority
on what each one accepts. resolve-grok-model.sh merges the two and flags any live
model missing from here as unknown, so a future release surfaces as a question
rather than a silent wrong-tier launch.
When a new Grok model ships: add its row here, then update the menu in
warfleet/references/muster.md. Nothing else needs to change.
